question: Does an event-derived owner timeline that holds ownership through explicitly non-changing Sportec duels outperform literal challenger assignment on Sportec's own BallPossession reference?
scope: Source-specific Sportec event-rule calibration on TRAIN only. Metrica targets are event-derived and SkillCorner interruption spans use a different target definition, so neither is used to select these parameters.

cohort.status: previously exposed development TRAIN matches; no fresh confirmation

protocol.outer: Leave one whole TRAIN match out; score the selected candidate once on the outer match.
protocol.inner: On each outer fold, score each fixed candidate separately on each of the other two whole TRAIN matches; select by equal-match mean spell_f1_mean, then mean macro_f1.
protocol.selection_tie_break: Prefer hold over literal, then 3-second over 0-second tail grace (the current-rule setting).
protocol.target_use: BallStatus/BallPossession are read only by the official scorer; they do not create event anchors, classify event types, or adjust event timing.
protocol.fitting: No learned model or normalization is fit; candidates are fixed rule configurations.

mapping.controlled_events: Play, OtherBallAction, BallClaiming, and TacklingGame with PossessionChange=true (new owner WinnerTeam).
mapping.uncontrolled_opponent_event: TacklingGame with PossessionChange=false; challenger is the team whose role is withoutBallControl.
mapping.dead_start: Restart DecisionTimestamp; otherwise Foul, Offside, FinalWhistle, GoalDisallowed, ShotWide, SuccessfulShot, or Goal event time.
mapping.dead_end: EventTime for ThrowIn, FreeKick, GoalKick, CornerKick, KickOff, or Penalty; team only from its own nested action annotation.
mapping.time_alignment: EventTime and DecisionTimestamp are converted relative to matchinformation KickoffTime and mapped to the nearest provider timestamp, with a fixed maximum 0.5-second alignment distance.
mapping.out_tail_grace: Propagate the current owner to dead_start only when the last control anchor is within the candidate grace; otherwise keep the gap X.
